mech_sense.name: Mechanism-Sense
mech_sense.narrationHints: The workings of a thing felt like a diagram behind the eyes.
mech_sense.description: Perceive how a mechanism or system functions on sight.
mech_sense.notFor: The why/meaning of it; living things.

tree.name: Mechanism-Sense
tree.grants: Understand a device or machine-system's function and flaws at a glance.
tree.cannot: Function, not purpose; the numinous stays dark.

tree.name: The Whole Mechanism
tree.grants: Read a machine entire — what it does, what it was FOR, where it will fail, and what someone changed.
tree.cannot: It reads mechanism. What a machine MEANS is the Numinous's country, not yours.

tree.name: The Engine's Confession
tree.grants: A mechanism tells you its whole history — every hand that touched it, every misuse, every repair made in a hurry.
tree.cannot: The Precursor works do not confess. They only answer, and only sometimes.

mind_read_folk.name: Cold-Read
mind_read_folk.narrationHints: The turn of a mind inferred from a hundred small signs.
mind_read_folk.description: Infer another's thoughts and intent from micro-signals — not magic, mastery of tells.

tree.name: Cold-Read
tree.grants: Deduce a person's likely thoughts and next move from their signals.
tree.cannot: Inference, not certainty; masters and non-humans resist.

tree.name: The Cold Line
tree.grants: Follow a mind's reasoning as it happens — where it is going, what it has already ruled out.
tree.cannot: You follow the reasoning, not the reasons. A mind moving on feeling is opaque to a cold line.

tree.name: The Open Book
tree.grants: A mind at rest is legible to you — its shape, its habits, the thing it keeps returning to.
tree.cannot: The Cogitants consider unbidden reading a violence, and they are right, and they do it anyway.

the_measuring_eye.name: The Weighing Look
the_measuring_eye.narrationHints: You are being looked at by something that is adding you up.
the_measuring_eye.description: See the moral weight a person carries — the first gift of the Ascent.
the_measuring_eye.notFor: Reading want (Appetite-Sense); reading truth (Verity). This reads WEIGHT — deed and cost.

tree.name: The Weighing Look
tree.grants: See roughly what a person carries — the harm done, the harm borne.
tree.cannot: It sees weight, not story. A heavy person may be heavy for good reasons.

tree.name: The Clear Ledger
tree.grants: See the specifics: what was done, to whom, and whether it was ever answered for.
tree.cannot: Seeing the ledger tempts you to collect on it. That is the Orders' besetting sin.

tree.name: The Unblinking Measure
tree.grants: Weigh anyone, at any distance, without their consent or knowledge.
tree.cannot: Nobody survives being weighed forever. Including you, and the Orders do it to their own.

the_kept_hour.name: The Long Foreseeing
the_kept_hour.narrationHints: You follow one thread of what-will-be all the way down — not a glimpse but the whole long braid of consequence, every branch, to where it finally comes to rest.
the_kept_hour.description: The Hourkeeper capstone — the long foreseeing, one possible future traced to its very end rather than glimpsed. To see this far is to carry a certainty most are mercifully spared, and to be bound to what you have seen.
the_kept_hour.notFor: One thread, once, at enormous cost — and what you see, you are bound by; a foreseeing this deep changes how you act, and acting changes the future you saw. You cannot un-know the end you followed to.

tree.name: The Long Foreseeing
tree.grants: Trace one possible future to its very end, seeing the whole braid of its consequence.
tree.cannot: It costs nearly all you have, it binds you to what you've seen, and the deepest mercy of not-knowing is one you have chosen to give up.

intensity.conserve: REFUSED — a half-traced future is a guess, and the Hourkeepers do not dignify guesses.
